description: This file contains PHP functions for generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of filesystem information, including details about mounted filesystems, their sizes, usage, and options, as part of a system information script.

methods.name: xml_filesystems
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing filesystem information for external use.

methods.name: html_filesystems
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying filesystem details with graphical usage bars.

methods.name: wml_filesystem
methods.description: Produces a WML card with filesystem information suitable for mobile devices.
